title: R' Ami bar Yechezkel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman identifies him as Rami bar Yechezkel and says he is mentioned under the heading’s Ami form in Jerusalem Talmud Taanit, chapter 2, halakhah 14, and Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin, chapter 6, halakhah 1, folio 27.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “This name” is read in relation to the heading Ami bar Yechezkel; the identification with Rami is Hyman’s. The historical folio 27 is retained without supplying an a/b side or assigning it to the Babylonian Talmud.

The whole selected Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:14 paragraph spells out Rabbi Immi bar Yechezkel in a transmission chain. The supplied headword Ami and Hyman’s identification with Rami remain his forms; the heading’s abbreviated title remains R'. All three whole paragraphs of the selected Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:1 were read without finding the named Ami/Rami bar Yechezkel report, a bounded nonmatch only. Hyman’s historical folio 27 and lack of an a/b side remain intact. The earlier mixed note remains verbatim; no alias or chronology is independently admitted.
